doc.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Young people's knowledge of jazz history in New Orleans
summary: Young players elsewhere think jazz began with Coltrane, but New Orleans youth know Buddy Bolden and Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: As some of the people I’ve talked to complain that some of the young people think that jazz history started with John Coltrane you know.

Well those kids don’t live in New Orleans obviously. You know if you were to ask young people about, well some of them really know about Buddy Bolden, you know, and those guys in that era. But in New Orleans if you were to ask some that maybe hadn’t been studying it they will tell you that Louis Armstrong was the first one. And that is the real unique thing about New Orleans is we know the history of the music.
